snippet.title: Little Tree Kingdom - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo Out Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938990/Little_Tree_Kingdom/utm_source=trailer&utm_medium=youtube

Ever imagined building a kingdom of gnomes on a giant tree?

In Little Tree Kingdom, you draft cards to grow your tree, build structures across its branches and roots, and guide your gnome civilization through the seasons. But watch out: monsters, disasters, and the changing weather won't make your journey to building the best tree-kingdom easy.

Your tree, your rules. Build it your way, one card at a time.
